title: Listening at the door as the Wolverines record Riverboat Shuffle
summary: At the Richmond piano warehouse studio he hears the Wolverines record before his own band's turn.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: Tell about going down there with the Chubb-Steinberg band and the Wolverines were there and you were outside the glass listening when Bix ---
Well, it wasn't the glass; we were out in the--- in was an old storage place for pianos---
and it was a storage building right on the railroad tracks and, uh, in fact, they had several; there are railroad tracks on both sides of the damn thing.
We ought to say that Gennett--- the recording company - is owned by the Star Piano Company---
Yeah - it was - yeah. That's right.
And, that's what you meant by the piano warehouse---

Yeah - well anyway, I remember standing out in the hall and listening with my ear to the door because it was all padded in there, you know, to keep the sound in and, uh, to hear the Wolverines. What is that?
The 'Riverboat Shuffle'--- I heard the band record that number.
Yeah - that's one of Bix's most famous recording, I guess.
Yeah but anyway, we were next in line ---when they left, we went in with our band. And---
